name: glitch title card hard-cuts into the chrome coin wordmark reveal
looks: A dim, scanlined divider card holds a short line of title text over a faint vertical glyph, then hard-cuts to the full brand reveal: the ring mark, now a glossy chrome coin tilted in 3D, sits beside the wordmark on a plain dark field with a small kicker line above it.
build: The divider card is a DOM layer with a seeded film-grain and scanline texture and a chromatic-aberration offset on the text; it holds about a beat, then hard-cuts with no crossfade to the coin-and-wordmark group, which fades and rises in together on power2.out over about 300ms.
sound: A low glitch hit on the divider, then a clean single chime as the full lockup lands.
prompt: Hold a short line of title text over a textured, scanlined divider for a beat, then hard-cut straight into the brand's full mark-and-name lockup, now rendered as a solid chrome medallion beside the wordmark, so the glitch clears into one clean, confident reveal.
